as_told.title: Eric Wargo's Time Loops on precognition

plain: The writer Eric Wargo argues in his book Time Loops that people can sense the future, and that the brain may work like a hybrid of an ordinary computer and a quantum one, able to reach information from moments that have not happened yet. Michels brings the book up on several episodes. In one he passes on Wargo's idea of a 'long body', a self stretched out through time, and in another he says Wargo, a past guest on his show, writes about people foreseeing events in their own lives. If it were right, it would mean information can travel backward in time to the mind.
